mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT idn) FROM loginlog WHERE SSTIME > (SYSDATE-7)
SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member_profile GROUP BY gender
SELECT NVL(SUBSTR(address, 1, INSTR(address, ' ') - 1),'기타') AS sido, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member_profile GROUP BY SUBSTR(address, 1, INSTR(address, ' ') - 1)

SELECT SUBSTR(address, INSTR(address,' ')+1) AS district, COUNT(*) AS value FROM member_profile WHERE SUBSTR(address, 1, INSTR(address, ' ') - 1) = #{sido} GROUP BY SUBSTR(address, INSTR(address,' ')+1)
SELECT TRUNC(ACTION_TIME) AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM like_request_log WHERE ACTION_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)-30 AND status='accepted' GROUP BY TRUNC(ACTION_TIME) ORDER BY TRUNC(ACTION_TIME)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_request WHERE RECEIVER_ID=#{nickname}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_request WHERE RECEIVER_ID=#{nickname} AND status='accepted'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM date_request WHERE RECEIVER_ID=#{nickname} AND status='accepted'

SELECT TRUNC(REQUEST_DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM like_request WHERE RECEIVER_ID=#{nickname} AND status='accepted' AND REQUEST_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)-6 GROUP BY TRUNC(REQUEST_DATE) ORDER BY TRUNC(REQUEST_DATE)
SELECT TO_CHAR(SSTIME,'HH24') AS hour, TO_CHAR(SSTIME,'D') AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM loginlog WHERE IDN=#{num} AND STATUS='login' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(SSTIME,'HH24'), TO_CHAR(SSTIME,'D')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_request WHERE RECEIVER_ID=#{nickname} AND STATUS!='pending'
SELECT NVL(AVG(resp_rate),0) AS avg_rate FROM ( SELECT nvl(COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS != 'pending' THEN 1 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 0) AS resp_rate FROM like_request GROUP BY RECEIVER_ID )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT idn) FROM loginlog WHERE STATUS='login' AND SSTIME BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE)-1 AND TRUNC(SYSDATE)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT idn) FROM loginlog WHERE STATUS='login' AND SSTIME >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE),-1)

SELECT '가입' AS stage, COUNT(*) AS count FROM MEMBER UNION ALL SELECT '좋아요', COUNT(*) FROM like_request UNION ALL SELECT '첫 매칭', COUNT(*) FROM like_request WHERE status='accepted' UNION ALL SELECT '데이트', COUNT(*) FROM date_request WHERE status='accepted'

SELECT gender, CASE WHEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE,birth)/12) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20대' WHEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE,birth)/12) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30대' WHEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE,birth)/12) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40대' ELSE '50대+' END AS age_group, COUNT(*) AS count FROM member_profile GROUP BY gender, CASE WHEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE,birth)/12) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20대' WHEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE,birth)/12) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30대' WHEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE,birth)/12) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40대' ELSE '50대+' END
SELECT TRUNC(SSTIME) AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT idn) AS count FROM loginlog WHERE SSTIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)-6 GROUP BY TRUNC(SSTIME) ORDER BY TRUNC(SSTIME)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT idn) FROM ( SELECT idn, sstime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY idn ORDER BY sstime DESC) AS rn, ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1) AS onemonth FROM loginlog WHERE STATUS='login' ) WHERE rn=1 AND onemonth > sstime
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT reip) FROM VISITORSLOG WHERE sstime > (SYSDATE-30)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE reg_date > (SYSDATE-30)
